title: Reverse-Engineering Akai: MESA II, the SCSI-over-WiFi Bridge, SysEx Protocols, and a Browser-Based Disk Parser
description: The long-form account of the Akai S-series reverse-engineering work: running MESA II inside a standalone 68k emulator, the Raspberry Pi SCSI-over-WiFi bridge, SysEx protocol archaeology, and the Akai disk parser + browser that reads legacy sampler volumes in the browser. Written for search — SCSI-protocol deep dive, MIDI-over-SCSI, MESA II emulation, Akai disk image format.
